claims.text: Reviewers frequently say these strips stay stuck to the teeth and don't slide or slip off, unlike other brands.
Many reviewers find these strips work as well as or better than name brands like Colgate and Crest, often at a lower price.
Reviewers commonly report seeing whitening results quickly, within a few days or applications.
Several reviewers describe the strips as easy and convenient to apply and use.
One reviewer reports the strips did not whiten teeth after two weeks and left a difficult-to-remove residue.
